Scholarship for ASAP Kerala Courses!
Avail Scholarships for ASAP courses
ASAP Kerala, functioning under the Department of Higher
Education, is offering an opportunity to learn new generation
courses with scholarship. There is an opportunity to study the
courses Game Developer, VR Developer, Artist, Programmer,
Wastewater Treatment Plant Technician, General Duty
Assistant, Communicative English Trainer with scholarship
ranging from 10% to 50%. These courses, conducted at ASAP’s
Community Skill Parks, include training in industrial
establishments in the respective fields.

List of Courses:
Wastewater Treatment Plant Technician
General Duty Assistant – Advanced
Communicative English Trainer
